verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents CPU+GPU weight offloading or any way to run models larger than available VRAM by splitting them across CPU and GPU. Quantization shrinks the memory footprint and multi-GPU parallelism spreads a model across GPUs, but both are adjacent features, not combined CPU+GPU offload. For an inference engine this axis clearly applies, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
